name: pakgit
description: PakGit - a cross-platform Git client for Windows, macOS and Linux
author: Taha Shahid

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n ng,electron "ng serve" "wait-on http://localhost:4200 && electron-vite build && cross-env ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:4200 electron ."
scripts.test:backend: esbuild test/backend-entry.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --alias:@shared=./src/shared --outfile=out/test/backend.cjs --log-level=error && node test/git-backend.test.cjs && node test/release.test.cjs && node test/organizations.test.cjs && node test/workindex.test.cjs && node test/releases.test.cjs && node test/phase4.test.cjs
scripts.release: node -e "console.log('Tag and push: git tag v' + require('./package.json').version + ' && git push origin --tags')"
